body: A 24-hour hackathon with Eightfold.AI focused on solving real-world hiring issues like fake hiring recommendations using machine learning. It drew 998 registrations and 300 live participants from top colleges (IIT Delhi, IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Roorkee, BITS Pilani). After a competitive prelims round, 20 finalist teams built solutions at IIT Delhi. The event saw 150+ submissions, 87k+ impressions, and earned praise from both experts and student clubs.
title: Eightfold.AI × ARIES Hackathon
